name: URJ Crane Lake Camp
description_short: Reform Jewish overnight camp in West Stockbridge, Massachusetts, run by the Union for Reform Judaism. Campers entering grades 2–10 come for 2-week, roughly 3–4-week, or full-summer sessions, and there is an Israel trip for grade 11.

warnings: Session prices shown are the URJ congregation member rates. Non-members pay $300 more per child, capped at $500 per family. Every session also has a security fee: $180 for K'tanim, $250 for all other sessions.

Availability is listed separately for Hillside (female-identifying campers) and Lakeside (male-identifying campers), as of October 8. 2nd Session Lower Chaverim is waitlisted on Hillside and 2nd Session Olim is waitlisted on Lakeside, so those two are marked 'unknown'.
Grades are the grades campers will be entering in 2027-2028. The source gives no ages.
1st Session ends on a Friday (July 23) for most groups, but K'tanim ends Sunday, July 11.

Discounts: sibling discount ($300 off the 2nd camper, $500 off each additional camper), $200 Consecration Certificate, and One Happy Camper grant of up to $1,000. Credit card payments carry a non-refundable 2.5% fee.
